title: Restore os_provision::dispatch and ambient::start_report as published Rust entry points (board 2919)
goal: Vision: V-9. Mandate 84 repair of T-GROKCORESIZE-3. Board 2919 (CORESIZEPLUG17): removing a public Rust function breaks downstream callers even with no in-repo caller. Restore both with their old diagnostics, default action and local side effects, and pin both signatures and behaviours in crates/susi-daemon/tests/public_daemon_api_contract.rs. Lands only together with an offsetting core cut so COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING never rises.

reuse.searched: The removed code at 7a11c556a~1 is restored byte-for-byte; the dispatch tests move from the old inline module into the public contract fixture.

limitations: Adds 39 counted lines (288,040 -> 288,079 measured on Windows). Not landable alone under Mandate 84 (core never grows); held on refs/agents/grok-coresize-4 until an offsetting cut rides with it.
